source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: The old unread rule already matched descendant sender and subject labels. Entry 692 adds .card-container to the existing selector, increasing class specificity while keeping both labels and the unread state. The reviewer asks for this change rather than a separate nested sender override; the author reports a Windows font-weight override. The fixed source retains the more specific selector. Correction: the old source lesson emphasized a missing descendant relationship, which the diff does not establish. Manual CSS review proposal for this component: inspect the competing rule and cascade before adding another override, and keep the shared unread state on both labels. No computed-style or live Windows check was run; historical c-c/beta reports are attributed in the audit. This does not impose a global ban on nested CSS.
title: Unread-card emphasis needs selector specificity, not a new descendant relationship
